messages:
Priya: quick recap from the design review this AM 12 want to propose a more compact IA: group Models + Deployments + Jobs under a single umbrella (thinking label: Serving) but add saved-view permalinks so teams can share exact UI state. e.g. /serving/models/123?pane=metrics or a short permalink /s/abcd1234. good for runbooks and support.

Liam: short and sweet. one caveat: query-string deep links are brittle for server-side routing and for private deployments with strict whitelists. path-based slugs are preferable when possible. also we should ensure old /models/:id links still work via route aliases or redirects.

Noah: a11y quick flag: when a permalink lands on a panel, we need deterministic focus handling. call focus() on the main heading of the panel, set aria-live="polite" to announce state, and ensure keyboard users can tab into the primary control immediately.

Zoe: copy nit: "Serving" vs "Workloads". internal debate: "Workloads" reads broader (models + jobs) but customers use "Serving" in support docs. suggestion: keep "Serving" as the group label and show secondary caption "Models, Deployments, Jobs" so it's discoverable.

Priya: agreed on caption approach. still want short permalinks. propose short id generation on the client that maps to a persisted UI-state object in our storage service; fallback to encoded state in URL if persistence fails.

Liam: example routing idea: use canonical paths for share links:

```
/serving/models/123
/serving/models/123/pane=metrics
/s/8f4b2a -> resolves to /serving/models/123/pane=metrics
```

and add simple route alias mapping for backwards compat:

```
{ from: '/models/:id', to: '/serving/models/:id' }
{ from: '/deploys/:id', to: '/serving/deployments/:id' }
```

serverless redirect worker or CDN edge rules can handle the 301s.

Noah: another a11y thing: for keyboard tree nav, if group node expands, set aria-expanded and move focus to the first child if user pressed Enter to expand. avoid surprising focus jumps if they used arrow keys. add skip links for screen reader users to jump to the list.

Zoe: analytics: funnels and dashboards are route-based. we need an event mapping shim so historical dashboards aren't invalidated. also include GA/Amplitude events for permalink opens and share clicks. ping @eng-bot to create a tracking task.

eng-bot: created task DESIGN-9023: "Nav IA + permalink events mapping" and assigned to product-analytics. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DESIGN-9023

ops-bot: rollout plan note: we'll gate the new IA behind feature-flag nav-ia-v2. start with 10% of web traffic in staging -> 25% canary in prod -> full. add migration smoke tests for internal saved links. include a private-deploy migration checklist.

Liam: technical follow-ups: trailing slash normalization to avoid breadcrumb duplication, consistent URL encoding for saved-view ids, and avoid exposing raw internal IDs in public permalinks. use a hashed short id.

Priya: action items: Liam to draft redirect/alias spec and short-id scheme, Noah to own a11y checklist + keyboard behavior tests, Zoe to draft copy caption and analytics mapping, ops-bot to document rollout flags and migration tests. I'll update the design doc with the caption mockups and permalink UX and post a diff by EOD. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
